name: 04-writer-conflict
description: There is no writer exclusion. MXL_ERR_CONFLICT is declared in mxl.h and returned from nowhere in the library: every flow mapping is opened LockMode::Shared, so a second writer on the same flow from a second instance succeeds. mxlIsFlowActive tests the flow with flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) and reports failure as 'active', so it means 'someone holds this flow open', not 'a writer is publishing' -- and it stays true until the LAST holder releases.

A.note: is_active true: our own shared lock is enough to make it so
STILL true: lane B's writer holds the flow, though this lane released it

B.note: the finding: a second writer on the same flow returns MXL_STATUS_OK
both writers are live on one ring; nothing in the ABI notices
MXL_ERR_FLOW_NOT_FOUND, not is_active false: releasing the LAST writer upgrades the shared lock to exclusive and deletes the flow (Instance.cpp:176)
